texts.Name: Name
texts.Configured: Configure this entitlement (unchecked means not granted)
texts.LoadingDefinition: Wait for the product's entitlement definitions to load.
texts.CatalogHelp: Manage registered products, configured plans and bundles. Publication changes affect future assignments only; existing entitlement snapshots remain unchanged.
texts.JavaScriptRequired: Enable JavaScript to use the paged lists and administration forms.
texts.ConfirmState: {0} “{1}”? Existing subscriptions will not be revoked. Archival is permanent.
texts.ConfirmDelete: Delete “{0}”? Referenced catalog items cannot be deleted; withdraw or archive them instead.
texts.PlanProductHelp: Select one product. A plan's product and code cannot change after creation.
texts.BundleCompositionHelp: Select at least two plans from different products. Each product may appear only once. Editing components returns the bundle to Draft; publish it again after review.
texts.DuplicateProduct: This bundle already contains a plan for that product. Remove it before choosing another plan.
texts.EntitlementHelp: Only code-registered features can be configured. Integer limits are non-negative; unlimited is explicit and available only when the definition permits it.
texts.NoFeatures: This product has no registered features.
texts.NoRegisteredProducts: No product definitions are registered. Ask the host administrator to register a definition provider in code.
texts.InvalidNumeric: Enter a non-negative integer within the registered maximum for {0}.
texts.FutureExpiration: Expiration must be in the future, or empty for no expiration.
texts.UserAdministrationHelp: Find users, review current assignments and history, and manage individual product subscriptions. There is no checkout or self-subscription.
texts.CurrentSlotsHelp: A current slot can be expired. Only Active subscriptions grant entitlements; replaced and revoked assignments remain in history.
texts.SnapshotHelp: These values were captured when assigned. Later plan edits do not change this snapshot.
texts.InvalidId: Enter a valid non-empty GUID, or leave an optional filter blank.
texts.AssignmentHelp: Select the target user above and a published plan or bundle below. Preview before assigning. A bundle creates separate subscriptions for its component products in one atomic operation.
texts.ReplacementWarning: Only the listed products are replaced. Other product subscriptions remain unchanged, even if they originally came from the same bundle. Each listed product gets an independent subscription and expiration.
texts.SelectUserAndPlan: Select a user and a plan or bundle first.
texts.FillAllExpiration: Expiration to fill into all products
texts.ExpirationHelp: Times are entered in your browser's local time and submitted as UTC. Leave empty for no expiration. Each product may have a different expiration.
texts.WillCreate: Create a subscription for this product; no current assignment exists.
texts.ConfirmAssignmentFor: Assign these independent product subscriptions to user {0}?
texts.ConfirmRevoke: Revoke the {0} subscription for user {1} immediately? History will be preserved.
texts.ConfirmExpiration: Change the expiration of {0} to {1}? The entitlement snapshot will not change.
